note: Round 27 toon: ZZZ-style thin outlines (post, depth based, near side of a depth step) and 3-band cel light in the lit-material chunk. ?toon=off installs nothing and restores round 26 pixel for pixel. lit.levels = direct-light level of the dark / middle / lit band relative to full sun; lit.edges = where the bands change (relative to full sun); lit.width = smoothstep width of those steps. line.width in pixels at 1100 px height; sil = relative depth step that starts / completes a silhouette line; crease = 1/depth curvature range; fade = metres where lines start thinning / vanish. line.tint multiplies the local colour (cool, not black).
